    items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)

    base_cols = [
        'sales_count', 'sales_last_30d', 'sales_last_90d', 'sales_last_180d',
        'total_revenue', 'total_freight', 'avg_price', 'avg_freight',
        'days_since_last', 'days_history', 'days_from_first', 'avg_inter_between',
        'review_count', 'avg_review_score', 'avg_review_score_90d',
        'delivered_count', 'delivered_share', 'avg_delivery_days',
        'canceled_share', 'avg_payment_value', 'avg_installments',
        'sales_prev_90d', 'sales_trend_90d', 'n_sellers', 'n_orders',
        'sales_30d_share', 'recency_weighted_sales'
    ]

    empty = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name='product_id'),
                         columns=base_cols)
    empty = empty.reindex(entity_ids)

    # --- Товарные позиции, известные на момент seed_time ---
    mask = items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids) & (items['ts'] <= seed_time)
    items_f = items.loc[mask].copy()
    if items_f.empty:
        return empty

    thr30 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    thr90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    thr180 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)

    # --- 1. Общие агрегаты ---
    agg = items_f.groupby('product_id').agg(
        sales_count=('order_id', 'count'),
        n_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        n_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique'),
        total_revenue=('price', 'sum'),
        total_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
        avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
        avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
        first_ts=('ts', 'min'),
        last_ts=('ts', 'max')
    )

    agg['days_since_last'] = (seed_time - agg['last_ts']).dt.days
    agg['days_history'] = (agg['last_ts'] - agg['first_ts']).dt.days
    agg['days_from_first'] = (seed_time - agg['first_ts']).dt.days
    agg['avg_inter_between'] = np.where(
        agg['sales_count'] > 1,
        agg['days_history'] / (agg['sales_count'] - 1),
        0.0
    )

    # --- 2. Продажи по окнам ---
    sales_30 = items_f[items_f['ts'] >= thr30].groupby('product_id').size()
    sales_90 = items_f[items_f['ts'] >= thr90].groupby('product_id').size()
    sales_180 = items_f[items_f['ts'] >= thr180].groupby('product_id').size()
    prev_90 = items_f[(items_f['ts'] < thr90) & (items_f['ts'] >= thr90 - pd.Timedelta(days=90))] \
        .groupby('product_id').size()

    agg['sales_last_30d'] = sales_30.reindex(agg.index).fillna(0)
    agg['sales_last_90d'] = sales_90.reindex(agg.index).fillna(0)
    agg['sales_last_180d'] = sales_180.reindex(agg.index).fillna(0)
    agg['sales_prev_90d'] = prev_90.reindex(agg.index).fillna(0)
    agg['sales_trend_90d'] = agg['sales_last_90d'] - agg['sales_prev_90d']
    agg['sales_30d_share'] = np.where(
        agg['sales_last_90d'] > 0,
        agg['sales_last_30d'] / agg['sales_last_90d'],
        0.0
    )

    # Экспоненциально затухающие продажи (recency-weighted)

    it['age_days'] = (seed_time - it['ts']).dt.days.clip(lower=0)
    it['w'] = np.exp(-it['age_days'] / 90.0)

    )

    agg = agg.join(rv).join(rv90)

    # --- 5. Платежи: только известные на seed_time ---
